method: Manual read-only inspection of relevant complete functions; no upstream copying, native compilation or execution.
conclusions: MenuBarWindow header defaults bFromMenu to true; KeyInput forwards with that default.
MouseButtonDown and MouseMove change root highlight with preselect false.
ImplCreatePopup refuses to recreate the already active popup.
HandleKeyEvent Up and Down both request first-entry preselection, as does Return when opening; Return on active popup closes it.
Popup ImplExecute always requests GrabFocus; Run and StartPopupMode focus the popup independently of first-entry preselection.
Invalid popup highlight navigates to first on Down and last on Up; Home and End use boundaries.
Status Bar is first in the currently implemented View subset, not the complete upstream View menu; composition is unchanged.
Native Space, full saved-document focus, disabled style defaults, mnemonics and mouse timing remain outside this opening correction.
